Description: SIMULATION: a scripted work-item source (TFS stand-in) for live-view testing — every id resolves to the configured story, with a configurable delay per operation. Never for production.

Settings.Label: Story title
Settings.HelpText: Title of the simulated story; default 'Simulated story'.

Settings.Label: Delay per operation (seconds)
Settings.HelpText: Every work-item operation sleeps this long — paces the run so the live view is watchable. Default 3.
